questions.question: The total salary of two employees, A and B, in an organisation was ₹40,000. After increasing the salary of A by 9% and of B by 11%, the total salary of A and B becomes ₹44,100. What was the initial salary of A?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

value of y after x% increment = ((100+x)/(100))y

**Calculation:**

Let the salary of A be x. Then the salary of B is 40000-x.

After increment, the total salary is,

(109)/(100)x+(111)/(100)(40000-x)=44100

Solving for x,

(109-111)/(100)x=44100-44400

x=(300×100)/(2)=15000 

**∴ The initial salary of A is Rs. 15000**

questions.question: 5 men can complete a work in 12 days, and 6 women can complete the same work in 20 days. In how many days can 1 man and 1 woman together complete this work?

5 men can complete a work in 12 days, and 6 women can complete the same work in 20 days.

If A does x amount of work in a day and B does y amount of work in a day, then the total work done by both together, in a day = (1)/(x)+(1)/(y)

**Calculation:**

Work done by 1 man in a day = (1)/(12times 5)=(1)/(60)

Work done by 1 woman in a day = (1)/(6times 20)=(1)/(120)

Work done by 1 man and q woman in a day = (1)/(60)+(1)/(120)=(3)/(120)=(1)/(40).

**∴ The number of days in which 1 man and 1 woman together can complete the work is 40.**

Solving for x,

x²=(24×8)/(3)64\x=sqrt{64}=8m

**∴ The width of the rectangle is 8 m.**

questions.question: If Δ ABC is similar to Δ DEF such that BC = 3 cm, EF = 4 cm and the area of Δ ABC = 54 cm², then the area of Δ DEF is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For similar triangles, the ratio of areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Area(ΔABC) ÷ Area(ΔDEF) = (BC ÷ EF)²

54 ÷ Area(ΔDEF) = (3 ÷ 4)² = 9 ÷ 16

Area(ΔDEF) = (54 × 16) ÷ 9 = 96 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 96 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ ΔABC is similar to ΔDEF

⇒ Base BC = 3 cm, Base EF = 4 cm

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 54 cm²

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Area(ΔABC) ÷ Area(ΔDEF) = (BC ÷ EF)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4f414ba3b0f0292774070a1e6a68abb5deff409a5c46ca1571f2c4dd071318b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 54 ÷ Area(ΔDEF) = (3 ÷ 4)²

⇒ 54 ÷ Area(ΔDEF) = 9 ÷ 16

⇒ Area(ΔDEF) = (54 × 16) ÷ 9

⇒ Area(ΔDEF) = 6 × 16

⇒ Area(ΔDEF) = 96 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 96 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Conditions for Similarity of Triangles

Two triangles are similar if their corresponding angles are equal (AAA similarity), or corresponding sides are proportional (SSS), or two corresponding sides are proportional with the included angle equal (SAS).

Properties of Similar Triangles

When two triangles are similar, the ratio of their corresponding perimeters, altitudes, medians, and angle bisectors is strictly equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of Areas of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area₁ ÷ Area₂ = (Side₁ ÷ Side₂)².

questions.question: A and B together can finish a work in 20 days. If they worked together for 8 days, then what was the share of work that was yet to be completed?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total time taken by A and B to complete the work = 20 days.

Part of the work completed by them in 1 day = 1/20.

Part of the work completed by them in 8 days = 8 × (1/20) = 2/5.

Share of remaining work = 1 − 2/5 = 3/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A and B together to complete the work = 20 days.

Number of days they worked together = 8 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work Done = Efficiency × Time

Remaining Work Fraction = Remaining Work ÷ Total Work

⇒ Work completed by A and B in 8 days = 8 × 1 = 8 units

⇒ Remaining work = 20 − 8 = 12 units

questions.question: The ratio of the number of boys to the number of girls in a class is 2 ∶ 5. If 10 boys leave the class and 20 new girls join the class, then the new ratio of boys and girls in the class becomes 4 ∶ 25. What is the number of boys in the class now?

questions.question: The difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on an amount of ₹1,500 for 2 years, at a given rate of interest per annum, is ₹60. What is the rate of interest per annum, if in the case of compound interest, the interest is compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal Amount = Rs 1500

Time = 2 years

Difference between CI and SI = Rs 60

**Concept Used:**

Compound Interest – Simple Interest = Principal × ((Rate)/(100))²

**Calculation:**

⇒ CI – SI = 1500 × (Rate)/(100)times (Rate)/(100)

⇒ Putting the values given in the question,

⇒ (Rate)/(100)times (Rate)/(100) = (60)/(1500)=(1)/(25)

⇒ Rate² = (1)/(25)times 100times 100

⇒ Rate² = 400

⇒ Rate = sqrt{400}=20\%

**Hence, the rate of interest per annum is 20%.**

questions.question: In what ratio must a supplier mix two varieties of pulses costing ₹10 per kg and ₹30 per kg, respectively, so as to get a mixture worth ₹15 per kg?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two varieties of pulses costing ₹10 per kg and ₹30 per kg, respectively are mixed to get a mixture worth ₹15 per kg.

**Formula used:**

Price of x kg = price per kg × x 

**Calculation:**

Let one kg of mixture with the worth of Rs. 15 contain x kg of pulses (A) costing ₹10 per kg and '1-x' kg of pulses (B) costing ₹30 per kg.

Then, 15 = 10x+30(1-x)

Solving for x,

x=(15)/(20) = (3)/(4)

And, 1-x=1-(3)/(4)=(1)/(4)

Ratio of A and B = 3 : 1

**∴ The ratio in which a supplier must mix two varieties of pulses costing ₹10 per kg and ₹30 per kg, respectively, so as to get a mixture worth ₹15 per kg is 3 : 1**

questions.question: The average age of 30 employees in an organisation is 25 years. If 2 new employees with an average age of 41 year join the organisation, then find the new average age of all the employees in the organisation.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of 30 employees in an organisation is 25 years. 2 new employees with an average age of 41 years join the organisation.

**Formula used:**

Sum of observations = average × no. of observations

**Calculation:**

Average = (30×25 + 2 × 41)/(32)=26

**∴ The new average age of all the employees in the organisation is 26 years.**

questions.question: The highest common factor and the least common multiple of two numbers are 12 and 120, respectively. If one of the numbers is 60, then what will be the other number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The highest common factor and the least common multiple of the two numbers are 12 and 120, respectively. One of the numbers is 60.

**Formula used:**

HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers. 

**Calculation:**

Let the other number be x.

Then, 12 × 120 = 60 × x

Solving for x,

x=(12×120)/(60)=24

**∴ The other number is 24.**
